_doc: Intel Officer cron jobs — source of truth. Uses opencli-hotspot-grabber skill with fallback (opencli→Chrome→requests). Do NOT edit via scheduler CLI; edit this file and sync.

jobs.name: Hotspot Grab - Morning Data (Overseas)
jobs.description: Morning raw data collection: HN + V2EX + GitHub + Dev.to + Lobsters. 抓取 → 汇总写入 topics-pool → 推送飞书群。
jobs.payload:
Morning hotspot grab + summary (overseas only):

1. python skills/opencli-hotspot-grabber/hotspot_grabber.py \
  -p hackernews v2ex github devto lobsters \
  -o tmp -q

2. Save raw data: /root/clawd/workspace-shared/topics/hotspots-overseas-$(date +%Y%m%d)-0830.json

3. Read tmp/opencli-hotspots-*.json, create topics-pool file:
   File: /root/clawd/workspace-shared/topics/topics-pool-cloud-$(date +%Y%m%d)-0830.md
   Format: ## P0 选题 \n- [平台] 标题 | 中文摘要 | 评分 | 来源链接
   Filter: AI/tech topics only, sort by score, top 20 items

4. Append raw data JSON path to topics-pool-cloud.md as reference

5. Send Feishu message to oc_2842f3a9c032f1ec76371316c6653823 with:
   - Top 5 AI topics with Chinese summaries
   - Platform breakdown counts
   - Link to raw JSON file

Expected count: ~84 items (hn:30, v2ex:8, github:14, devto:12, lobsters:20)
jobs._notes: 2026-04-01: Complete workflow: grab → aggregate → write topics-pool → push Feishu.

jobs.name: Intel Morning Hot Topics -> Shared Pool (Cloud)
jobs.description: Morning intel analysis using PIPELINE v2.0. Reads accumulated data, filters AI topics, scores, ranks, and writes to cloud topics pool (cloud-naming to avoid local conflict).
jobs.payload:
Morning intel analysis - PIPELINE v2.0:

python skills/opencli-hotspot-grabber/pipeline.py --analyze \
  -i tmp/opencli-hotspots-*.json \
  --output-pool ../workspace-shared/topics/topics-pool-local-$(date +%Y%m%d)-0830.md \
  --mode morning

Pipeline auto:
- Reads all tmp/opencli-hotspots-*.json (accumulated data)
- Filters AI/tech topics only
- Applies quality scoring (positive/negative rules built-in)
- Ranks by final_score
- Writes P0/P1/P2 sorted topics

Announce: Top 5-10 P0 topics with counts.
jobs._notes: PIPELINE v2.0 - local writes to topics-pool-local.md

jobs.name: Intel Officer Heartbeat
jobs.description: Light heartbeat for intel-officer; report only if action is needed. Checks grab-v2 data freshness, morning/afternoon runs, downstream handoff, shared topic freshness, and delivery state.
jobs.payload: Check intel-officer health: 1) tmp/hotspots-v2-*.json freshness (should exist for today), 2) morning and afternoon hotspot runs completed, 3) the 15:20 downstream handoff to bot2, 4) shared topic file in ../workspace-shared/topics/ exists and is today's, 5) delivery state. If everything is healthy, stay silent; otherwise report only the concrete issue and next action.
